name: Mirror
environment_controls: WASD move; mouse look; Space jump; Shift sprint. 1 shovel, 2 pickaxe, 3 axe, 4 bucket. Hold left mouse for force, release to work; right mouse empties the tool. Click the theatre computer to open the audio workstation. VR/AR glasses beside it: F pick up/place on a surface, B wear/remove, E open the same DAW while worn. Aim at the phone and press F to pick up or place it with an empty tool; R focuses a held phone, otherwise resets the session only with cheats enabled. Pause, enable Cheats, and enable Night vision for a full-bright cave inspection. Escape releases phone focus, then pauses. Mobile: left drag moves, right drag looks; select a tool, hold Work and release; Pour empties it. Tap the phone to pick up/focus/select; Lower phone / Put down phone releases it. Physical material sites remain for this session. Cave jars: F opens a jar and carries its plank blueprint; F places it on ground. Place near a felled tree and Shift-left-click to craft for 60 local seconds. Stay within 10 metres for full speed; at 20 metres crafting is 100x slower. F picks up/places each finished plank.
